pieces.name: adr-use-postgres
pieces.summary: Postgres 16 was chosen for all services for strong relational consistency; migrations run via the migrate tool and every migration must be reversible.
pieces.readWhen: choosing or justifying the database technology, or writing/reviewing a migration

links.note: records the decision behind the database choice
names the migrate tool used to apply migrations

pieces.name: adr-no-orm
pieces.summary: SQL is written by hand with a thin query helper instead of using an ORM.
pieces.readWhen: writing database access code or deciding whether to add an ORM

links.note: specifies the raw-SQL, no-ORM data access approach

pieces.name: adr-feature-flags-config-service
pieces.summary: Feature flags must live in the config service for gradual rollout, never as code constants, and must be cleaned up after use per the house rules.
pieces.readWhen: adding or removing a feature flag, or deciding where flag state should be stored

links.note: records the decision to store flags in the config service
cleanup requirement points to the house rules
